# Progress ring (`progress-ring`)

Circular progress with a value in the middle.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createProgressRing` (types in `dist/web/feedback/progress.d.ts`): `.mh-progress-ring`: circular progress with the value in the middle. Parts `__svg`, `__track`, `__arc`, `__value`. Without a value it spins (indeterminate).

```ts
export function createProgressRing(options: ProgressRingOptions): ProgressRingHandle;

export interface ProgressRingOptions {
  value?: number | null;
  max?: number;
  label: string;
  /** Shows the value in the middle (default true). */
  showValue?: boolean;
  valueText?: string;
  tone?: ProgressTone;
  size?: ProgressSize;
}

export interface ProgressRingHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValue(value: number | null, valueText?: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createProgressRing } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const total = 8;
let done = 3;

const ring = createProgressRing({ label: 'Rooms set up', value: done, max: total, valueText: `${done}/${total}`, size: 'large' });

const next = createButton({
  label: 'Set up next room',
  variant: 'secondary',
  onClick: () => {
    done = Math.min(total, done + 1);
    ring.setValue(done, `${done}/${total}`);
    if (done === total) next.setDisabled(true);
  },
});

document.body.append(ring.el, next.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, ProgressRing } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const total = 8;

export function ProgressRingExample() {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(3);
  return (
    <>
      <ProgressRing label="Rooms set up" value={done} max={total} valueText={`${done}/${total}`} size="large" />
      <Button variant="secondary" disabled={done === total} onClick={() => setDone((n) => Math.min(total, n + 1))}>
        Set up next room
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```
